pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Public, self-serve pricing. Pay only for leads you accept.
pricing.heading: Simple, public pricing
pricing.subheading: Every plan is listed here. There is no sales-rep-only price and nothing hidden.
pricing.p1d: One credit is spent when you accept a lead. Receiving or declining a lead costs nothing.
pricing.p2d: If a buyer is unreachable or flagged fake within 72 hours, the credit comes back automatically. No ticket needed.
pricing.p3d: Unused credits stay spendable for 90 days, so a slow month does not waste them.
pricing.p4d: Plans never renew or upgrade on their own. You confirm every purchase.
pricing.p5d: Account, Plan, Cancel. Self-serve, no calls and no retention hoops.
pricing.p6d: Your plan never changes your verification badge or how you rank. Ranking is relevance and trust.

consent.bannerText: {site}, as data fiduciary, uses essential cookies to run this site. With your permission we also use analytics cookies to improve it, marketing cookies to measure campaigns and preference cookies to remember things like recently viewed products. Nothing optional is used unless you accept. <link>Cookie policy</link>
consent.dialogIntro: Choose which optional cookies and similar storage {site} may use. Essential ones are always on because the site cannot work without them. You can change your choice at any time from Cookie settings in the footer.
consent.gpcNote: Your browser's Global Privacy Control signal is on, so marketing stays off unless you switch it on here.
consent.necessaryDesc: Needed for sign-in, security, your language and delivery pincode, and to remember this choice. They cannot be switched off.
consent.analyticsDesc: Microsoft Clarity records anonymised usage (clicks, scrolling, page views) so we can find and fix problems. Form entries are masked.
consent.marketingDesc: Remembers an anonymous visitor ID, which sponsored listing you clicked and where you came from (campaign links), and how often we show supplier-quote prompts.
consent.functionalDesc: Remembers things that make the site easier for you, such as the products you recently viewed on this device. Nothing here is used for advertising.

purpose.auth: Keeps you signed in for a few minutes at a time (short-lived access token).
purpose.session: Keeps you signed in on this device (refresh token, revoked when you sign out).
purpose.oauth: Protects the Google sign-in round trip against forgery.
purpose.mfa: Holds a pending two-step sign-in for a few minutes.
purpose.rail: Remembers whether you expanded or collapsed the side menu.
purpose.pincode: Remembers the delivery pincode you entered.
purpose.compare: Holds the products in your compare list.
purpose.langSuggestion: Remembers that you dismissed the language suggestion.
purpose.voiceConsent: Remembers that you agreed to the voice search notice.
purpose.clarityId: Microsoft Clarity: recognises your browser to group your visits.
purpose.claritySession: Microsoft Clarity: links the page views of one visit.
purpose.clarityMs: Set by Microsoft while Clarity runs: recognises the browser across Microsoft services.
purpose.visitor: Anonymous visitor ID that links your visit to a supplier enquiry.
purpose.adClick: Remembers which sponsored listing you clicked, so a later enquiry can be attributed to it.
purpose.attribution: Records the campaign link (UTM) or website you came from, for this visit.
purpose.nudgeHistory: Counts how often we showed a supplier-quote prompt, so we do not repeat it too often.
purpose.nudgeViews: Counts the products you viewed in this visit, to decide when to show a quote prompt.
purpose.nudgeSession: Marks the start of this visit for the quote prompt.
purpose.recentlyViewed: Remembers the products you viewed on this device, so we can show them again as “Recently viewed”. Never sent to our servers.
purpose.consentPending: Holds your latest cookie choice until our server confirms it has saved the record of it.
purpose.consentSync: Remembers, for this visit only, that your cookie choice was checked against your account.

consent.policyDescription: Which cookies and similar storage {site} uses, why, for how long, and how to change your choice.
consent.whatBody: Cookies are small text files a website saves in your browser. We also use similar browser storage (local and session storage). Some are essential; the rest are used only if you agree.
consent.categoriesBody: We group them into three categories. Essential ones are always on. Analytics and marketing are off until you accept them, and refusing them never limits what you can do on {site}.
consent.changeBody: You can change your choice at any time; withdrawing is as easy as giving consent. When you withdraw, we stop that use and delete the related cookies and storage.
consent.gpcBody: If your browser sends the Global Privacy Control signal, we treat marketing as switched off by default. You can still switch it on yourself in the preferences.
consent.proofBody: When you choose, we keep a record: a random consent ID, your choices, the policy version, your language and the time. It holds no IP address or browser details. We keep it for 3 years as proof of consent. Your choice expires after 12 months, when we ask again.
consent.grievanceBody: Contact our Grievance Officer if you have a question or complaint about how we use cookies or your personal data.
consent.accountBody: Change your cookie choices for analytics and marketing on this device at any time.
consent.consentIdHelp: Quote this ID if you contact us about your cookie choice. It identifies this browser, not you.
consent.idCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the ID and copy it by hand.
consent.noChoiceYet: You have not made a choice yet, so there is no consent ID.
